main_text.l: In Apuleio , ipsa de se Isis:
Eusebius de Præparatione : Φασὶ τοίνυν Αἰγύπτιοι τ̀ μὲν Ὀσίριν

l.i: εἶναι τ̀ Διόνυσον, τὴν δὲ Ἴσιν τὴν Δήμη-τρα: Aiunt Ægyptii Osirim

main_text.l: ¹ Lib. xi. de Asin. ² Lib. ii. cap. i.

page.notes: Greek and Hebrew-like forms in the Eusebius and Herodotus passages are approximate; marginal notes "Cereri", "Pharia sive", "Ægyptia" are read from the right margin; the Herodotus Greek is uncertain. Lower part of page is faded with stains.
